summary: ONE_FORWARD_VOLATILITY_PERSISTENCE_DIAGNOSTIC_SPEC_READY. The frozen repository contracts support one causally isolated forward volatility-persistence sibling using accepted COMPLETE_UTC_DAY evidence, active rollover lineage, Server Canonical as sole writer, the sole V10 Cloud Ops heartbeat and the existing ResearchStore/outbox. The diagnostic must require one active leaf and exactly 23 contiguous accepted UTC days D-21 through D+1; bind every source artifact, chain head, lineage identity, shock diagnostic, evaluator contract and later activation receipt; calculate only the frozen RV24/BaselineRV20/OutcomeRatio formula; and apply the frozen breadth and terminal decision gates without tuning. It can be integrated after the existing post-shock child and before event sorting and Coach delivery without changing the directional evaluator, source, schedule or writer. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero. Forward predictive, causal and economic value remain MISSING_PROOF.

checks.evidence: Freeze a later Manager-accepted deployment activation receipt containing the accepted implementation commit, task/result hashes, evaluator contract/schema hashes, deployed-source provenance and active-leaf identity. A target is eligible only when both target evidence received_at and shock diagnostic sealed_at are strictly later than activated_at. Earlier same-leaf D-21 through D-1 days may serve only as baseline context. No activation date or forward episode is selected now.

checks.name: SAME_LEAF_23_DAY_CLOSURE
checks.evidence: Each episode requires exactly 23 contiguous complete accepted UTC days D-21 through D+1 from one active leaf. D is a shock only when abs(close[D,23]/close[D-1,23]-1) is at least 0.0300 inclusive. Missing days, incomplete evidence, leaf changes, lineage drift, copied observations and backfill fail closed.

checks.name: FORMULA_FREEZE
checks.evidence: Freeze formula version BTC_UTC_DAY_3PCT_RV24_BASELINE20_OUTCOME_RATIO_V1: hourly simple return equals close divided by the prior hourly close minus one; RV24 is the sum of the 24 squared hourly returns; BaselineRV20(D) is the ordinary median of RV24 for D-20 through D-1; OutcomeRatio is RV24(D+1) divided by BaselineRV20(D). No alternative estimator, window, transform or threshold is permitted.

checks.name: EPISODE_AND_SNAPSHOT_IDENTITY
checks.evidence: The episode identity must canonically bind evaluator contract hash, formula version, activation-receipt hash, root and leaf ids/fingerprints, target and outcome accepted references, all ordered 23 artifact paths/hashes/chain heads/received_at values, and shock-diagnostic path/hash. Create-only snapshot identity must additionally bind the ordered episode identities. Exact source revalidation, immutable bytes, deterministic keys and one terminal prefix are required.

checks.name: BREADTH_AND_TERMINAL_GATE_TABLE
checks.evidence: WAIT until at least 12 unique eligible episodes, at least three UP and three DOWN shocks, at least three episodes in each chronological half, at least four distinct target UTC months, maximum month share at most 0.40 and maximum single-episode share of total absolute OutcomeRatio-minus-one at most 0.40. At the first qualifying prefix RETAIN only if overall median OutcomeRatio is at least 1.10, both direction medians exceed 1.00 and the share above 1.00 is at least 0.55; otherwise CLOSE. If breadth remains incomplete at 24 episodes, CLOSE. No tuning or rescanning is allowed.

checks.name: LIFECYCLE_AND_EVENT_BOUNDARY

A terminal snapshot emits at most one deduplicated generic event containing only disposition, counts, gates, artifact path/hash, zero immediate PnL/drawdown and MISSING_PROOF boundaries.
